notes.title: Idle Space - Linux & Expanded Story Mode Release
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.6
[list]
[*] Added: SteamOS & Linux support
[*] Added: Mac beta branch
[*] Added: Expanded story & side missions
[*] Added: Improved mission objective text
[*] Added: Official Discord invite button
[*] Added: Purchase amounts 1x, 5x, 10x & 25x
[*] Added: 4 special scrap types
[*] Added: 10 unique power core buffs
[*] Added: A power core buff slot
[*] Added: New enemy fleet models
[*] Added: Render cap setting
[*] Added: Ability to group mercenaries into squads
[*] Added: Keyboard shortcut F5 to hide user interface
[*] Added: Keyboard shortcut F9 to take a screenshot
[*] Added: New achievements for expanded story
[*] Added: Save converter (Automatic)
[*] Added: Version control for config file
[*] Balancing pass #5
[*] Fix: Sound adjustments #1
[*] Fix: Removed a story bypass bug
[*] Fix: Locale update
[*] Fix: Major FPS Improvements
[*] Fix: Major engine optimizations
[/list]
Update 1.0.5
[list]
[*] Fix: Lowered scrap crate HP
[*] Fix: Adjusted logic to match story
[*] Fix: Locale update
[/list]
